title: Fuzzy-Match Calibration Scorer
description: FPR/recall/F1 scoring and threshold calibration for sanctions fuzzy-match engines. Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, and Phonetic algorithms. Wolfsberg-aligned. Synthetic name pairs only — zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: score_fuzzy_match_calibration
mcp_tool_definition.description: Score and calibrate a sanctions fuzzy-match engine using Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, or Phonetic algorithms. Returns F1, precision, recall, FPR, confusion matrix, and Wolfsberg-aligned grade A–F. Use when an agent needs to validate or tune a sanctions screening threshold against labelled name pairs.
